headline: Treasure Coast Today launches free iPhone app for local news and events
subhead: The new app makes it easy to follow Treasure Coast headlines, receive timely alerts and discover local events.
teaser: Treasure Coast Today is now on iPhone. Download the free app for local news, timely alerts and community events across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.
body:
Treasure Coast Today is now available as a free iPhone app, giving readers another way to stay connected to the news and events shaping Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.

The app brings Treasure Coast Today's local coverage into a dedicated iPhone experience, with easy access to top stories, timely news alerts and a calendar of community events. Whether you're following a developing story in Port St. Lucie, checking what's happening in Stuart or looking for weekend plans in Vero Beach, local information is just a tap away.

## Local news, wherever the day takes you

Readers can use the app to:

- **Follow Top News:** Catch up on the stories affecting communities across the Treasure Coast.
- **Get timely alerts:** Stay informed when important local developments happen.
- **Explore community events:** Find things to do throughout Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties.
- **Read and share stories:** Open articles, explore related coverage and share stories with friends and neighbors.

The app is designed to make it simpler to check in on local news throughout the day, whether at home or on the go.

## Download Treasure Coast Today for iPhone

The Treasure Coast Today app is **free to download** from Apple's App Store.

**[Download Treasure Coast Today on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/treasure-coast-today/id6821545564)**

Prefer reading in a browser? The full local news site remains available at [treasurecoast.today](https://treasurecoast.today/), with free access to our coverage.

Treasure Coast Today is an independent local news site serving Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties. The iPhone app is another way for readers to stay informed about the place they call home.
